text:
Alex W: quick sync — we have a cross-repo rollout that needs ordering + approvals. SDK PR #438 (auth header change) -> API PR #219 (compat shim) -> Console PR #102 (console UI + helm bump). currently SDK is approved but blocked on integration tests, API is new and needs an explicit OK before console merges. can folks confirm windows?

Maya C: I can take SDK #438 review today, aiming to finish by EOD. saw the failing test in `auth_integration_test::header_roundtrip` — looks like a header canonicalization edge. I can add a small stub to make CI green while we land the shim in API. :+1:

Jorge R: I can review API #219 but need the compatibility shim to pass our api-compat checks. can you paste the failing curl example? also we should add a short migration note in api/CHANGELOG.md so infra knows the header semantics changed.

Alex W: failing curl snippet from SDK CI: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer token" -d '{"q":"hi"}' https://api.internal/v1/infer -H "X-Client-Version: 1.2.0"` — test expects header `authorization` normalized lowercase. SDK was normalizing differently after the change.

Sam T: for Console #102 I'll hold off merging until API is green. Helm chart lint failed in staging because of a values schema bump. re-run lint with: ```bash
helm lint ./charts/console --set image.tag=canary
``` I can do a quick chart patch once API merges.

CI Bot: Pipeline report for SDK #438 — integration (auth_integration_test) failed: https://ci.redwood/integrations/438/jobs/1123 — failing job: `integration-auth-1` — see logs.

Maya C: thanks CI Bot, I'm on it. quick plan: I'll push a temporary normalization helper to SDK that keeps current public behavior but logs a deprecation warning. that should satisfy API tests. once API merges we can remove the helper in a follow-up.

Jorge R: ack. once SDK pushes that helper I'll run `make test-integration` locally and re-run `scripts/api-compat-check.sh`. if green I'll approve API #219. can we target a merge window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PT?

Linda P: FYI product wants a canary for one hour after merge (console + runtime). we should schedule a rollback checkpoint at +60m. also please tag the rollout with `canary/feature-auth-headers` so observability dashboards pick it up.

Alex W: ordering summary + asks: (1) Maya pushes temporary helper to SDK #438 (2) CI green -> Alex asks Jorge to run compat checks and approve API #219 (3) Sam waits and does helm bump + console patch (4) Merge window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PT, canary for 60m, rollback if errors. can everyone react with :thumbsup: if agreeable and drop blockers now.

Sam T: :thumbsup: I'll block off 10:00-11:30 PT and keep an eye on sts/console logs.

Maya C: pushed fix: `github.com/redwood/sdk@438-patch-header-normalize` — CI rerun triggered. pinging @Jorge R for compat check when it passes.

CI Bot: SDK #438 — re-run complete — all tests passed. https://ci.redwood/integrations/438/jobs/1124

Jorge R: running local compat now. small note: API tests flagged a docstring mismatch in `v1/openapi.yaml` — I'll push a tiny docs-only commit to #219 if nothing else. planning to approve after docs commit.

Alex W: perfect. I'll update the rollout doc in #release-notes with the canary tag and rollback instructions, and add a short checklist: install helm chart with `helm upgrade --install` then monitor `/metrics` and `logs:service=console` for 60m.

Linda P: added the product notification and schedule. :eyes:

Jorge R: approved API #219 (post docs fix) and left a note about the compatibility test results.

Alex W: thanks everyone — merging plan in place. will merge SDK at 10:00:00 PT, then API at 10:05 PT, then console at 10:15 PT. will post a final short thread update right before merges.

Sam T: copy, will run helm lint + patch at 10:12 and start canary deployment at 10:15.

Maya C: thanks — feel free to ping me if any auth-related regressions show up during canary.

Alex W: final note: if rollback needed, follow `runbooks/rollbacks/console-helm.md` and tag #oncall. I'll ping then. :rocket:
